guide_line: Every bond has one sigma. Extra bonds in a double or triple bond are pi.
steps: A sigma bond is head-on overlap along the line between two atoms.
A pi bond is side-by-side overlap of p orbitals, above and below that line.
Every bond has exactly one sigma. A single bond is that sigma only. A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi. A triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi.
Add the bonds in the whole molecule. Lone pairs are not bonds.

worked_example.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in H2?
steps: A single bond is 1 sigma and 0 pi.

similar_problem.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in O2?
similar_problem.hint: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in H2?
problems.why: H2 has one single bond. That is 1 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
A single bond is only a sigma bond.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in O2?
problems.why: O2 has one double bond. A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
Count one sigma for the bond, then one pi for the second overlap.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in N2?
problems.why: N2 has one triple bond. A triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
A triple bond has one sigma and two pi bonds.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in CO2?
problems.why: CO2 is O=C=O, two double bonds. Each double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, so the molecule has 2 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
CO2 has two double bonds. Add them.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in C2H4?
problems.why: C2H4 has four C–H single bonds and one C=C double bond. The double bond adds 1 sigma and 1 pi, so the total is 5 sigma and 1 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
Count four C–H sigma bonds plus the C=C bond.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in C2H2?
problems.why: C2H2 has two C–H single bonds and one C≡C triple bond. The triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi, so the total is 3 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
A triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi. Add the two C–H sigma bonds.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in HCN?
problems.why: HCN is H–C≡N. The C–H bond is 1 sigma. The triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi. The total is 2 sigma and 2 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
A triple bond is 1 sigma and 2 pi. The C–H bond is another sigma.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in CH2O?
problems.why: CH2O has two C–H single bonds and one C=O double bond. That is 3 sigma and 1 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
Count two C–H sigma bonds plus the C=O bond.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in CH4?
problems.why: CH4 has four C–H single bonds and no multiple bond. That is 4 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
Each single bond is one sigma.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in C2H6?
problems.why: C2H6 has six C–H single bonds and one C–C single bond. That is 7 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
Ethane has only single bonds. Count all seven.

problems.q: How many sigma and pi bonds are in H2O?
problems.why: H2O has two O–H single bonds. Lone pairs are not bonds, so the total is 2 sigma and 0 pi.
hints: A double bond is 1 sigma and 1 pi, not 2 sigma.
Lone pairs are not sigma or pi bonds.
